keyEvents.text: Goal! MK Dons 1, Swindon Town 0. Marvin Ekpiteta (MK Dons) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Aaron Collins.
Goal! MK Dons 2, Swindon Town 0. Aaron Collins (MK Dons) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Elijah Campbell.
